name: HD Hyundai Energy Solutions Co.,Ltd.
summary: HD Hyundai Energy Solutions Co.,Ltd. provides solar cells and modules. It offers monofacial, bifacial, and shingled PV modules; transformer-less and outdoor box inverters; and ground, floating, and agro PV solutions, as well as smart solar city. HD Hyundai Energy Solutions Co.,Ltd. was formerly known as Hyundai Energy Solutions Co.,Ltd and changed its name to HD Hyundai Energy Solutions Co.,Ltd. in April 2023. HD Hyundai Energy Solutions Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2004 and is based in Seongnam-si, South Korea. HD Hyundai Energy Solutions Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of HD Korea Shipbuilding & Offshore Engineering Co., Ltd.
